title: Define a Spark Declarative Pipelines Expectations Pipeline
description: Fill in the blanks to create a Spark Declarative Pipelines (SDP, formerly Delta Live Tables) pipeline with data quality expectations that validate incoming data.
hints: dp.expect() sets a warning-level quality check (called inside the function body)
dp.expect_or_drop() removes records that fail the check (called inside the function body)
explanation: Spark Declarative Pipelines (SDP, formerly DLT) simplifies ETL pipelines with declarative definitions and built-in data quality. dp.expect() logs violations but keeps records. dp.expect_or_drop() removes violating records. dp.expect_or_fail() stops the pipeline on violations. This provides graduated data quality enforcement through the medallion architecture. Import: from pyspark import pipelines as dp.
